note: The built-in Generic profile: general sheet-metal design practice in SolidCraft's own words, with each value stated as a multiple of the sheet thickness (t) or the inside bend radius (R). It is not any shop's rules: your shop's numbers belong in a preset.

profiles.name: Generic
profiles.note: General sheet-metal design practice, not any shop's rules. Distances are multiples of the sheet thickness t and the inside bend radius R, the rules of thumb taught for laser, punch and press-brake parts. Hole to bend is measured to where the bend starts, the stricter reading. It has no stock list or sheet size. Your shop's numbers belong in a preset: save one from this profile and edit it.

sources.says: general practice: a cutter takes every line on its layer as a cut, so a file for cutting has one layer of cut paths, with bend lines and notes left out
general practice: a flat pattern is made from one solid sheet-metal body, so a part file holds one body and an assembly is split into its parts
general practice: a sheet part is cut from one thickness of stock, so every feature is modelled at the same thickness
general practice: a hole is at least as wide as the sheet is thick, a common rule of thumb for punched and cut holes
general practice: the rim of a hole is at least two thicknesses from the sheet's edge, so the web left does not tear or bulge
general practice: the rim of a hole is at least 2.5 thicknesses plus the inside bend radius from a bend, so bending does not stretch the hole out of round
general practice: a flange is at least four thicknesses long, so it rests on the die of a press brake when it is bent
general practice: a tapped hole is drawn as a plain hole of the tap-drill size and the thread is named on the order
general practice: every cut path of the flat DXF is on one layer, with construction lines and notes on other layers or left out
general practice: every cut path of the flat DXF is a closed shape, and no line is drawn twice or overlaps another
general practice: text in the flat DXF is converted to outlines, as editable text is not cut geometry
